propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered jobs on main dominated the 2026-08-12/13 Actions runner starvation, not tickets-branch pushes; tickets branch is an orphan with no .github/ directory and produced zero push runs

Current full-route Verified workflow creates immediate 13-job fan-out after classify, with maximum 24 runner jobs per run (17 base + up to 7 mutation shards), consuming 65-116 runner-minutes per run and saturating the navapbc Free plan 20-job concurrency ceiling

Incident-period peak on 2026-08-13 20:30 UTC reached 22 waiting jobs and 873s max runner wait across seven dispatches; current-period peak on 2026-08-15 17:30 UTC reached 22 waiting jobs with 197s max wait across three independent full-route runs
Organization plan is Free (20 total / 5 macOS concurrent limit, verified via org API); no higher-level organization-wide queue depth is observable to the repository credential

Four mutually exclusive remediation options are costed: Option A bundles four preflights and caps mutation at 3 shards (reduces immediate fan-out 13→10, peak 19→12 jobs), Option B extends Change-Id coalescing but has minimal effect on independent-change bursts, Option C moves macOS to scheduled main-health (saves 9-11m latency but weakens pre-merge coverage), and Option D upgrades to Team plan (60 total / 5 macOS, operationally simple but recurring cost)

Recommendation is Option A (coverage-neutral demand reduction) as the first intervention; it requires workflow changes to gerrit-verify.yaml, _mutation.yml, preflights, and CI parity tests, and must be approved and plan-reviewed before implementation
